lede: The day's loudest signal was a true-crime revival, told without a dash of hype. Lizzie Borden drew 586,575 Wikipedia views, more than triple the next name on the list, and she had company: a dramatization, Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story, trended right beside her, while Aileen Wuornos and Elizabeth Holmes filled out a page dominated by infamous women. The one story that truly jumped feeds was political, ProPublica's report that the FBI had been circling Senator Collins over a defense contractor's donations, live on Bluesky and Mastodon at the same moment.

throughlines.title: NEW: ProPublica revealed that the FBI was circling Sen. Collins over a defense contractor’s donations — until Trump gutt
throughlines.gist: ProPublica reported the FBI was examining Senator Collins over a defense contractor's donations, and the piece surfaced on Bluesky and Mastodon at once, the day's clearest cross-feed signal.
